about: Synthetic interview notes for the #806 consistency measure (comment 5983938383, section 2): one class per kind of note, written generically so any CSF subcategory or Zero Trust capability can carry it. Invented text only: no client data, no person's name and no secret.

`--notes-corpus` writes these notes over the measured assessment's answer rows in the throwaway database, in sorted row order, class by class in turn, before the route's own payload builder runs. Stored stages, tiers and evidence are left as they are.
{{CLIENT_NAME}} is replaced by the assessment's client legal name, so the redactor sees a real client name to replace.
